papers.title: Reduced-Order Modeling Of Hidden Dynamics
papers.abstract: The objective of this paper is to investigate how noisy and incomplete observations can be integrated in the process of building a reduced-order model.   This problematic arises in many scientific domains where there exists a need for accurate low-order descriptions of highly-complex phenomena, which can not be directly and/or deterministically observed. Within this context, the paper proposes a probabilistic framework for the construction of "POD-Galerkin" reduced-order models. Assuming a hidden Markov chain, the inference integrates the uncertainty of the hidden states relying on their posterior distribution. Simulations show the benefits obtained by exploiting the proposed framework.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一个结合不确定性量化的降阶建模方法，可转移到生物力学FEA代理模型的设计中。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to any biomedical or implant-related problem, nor does it address design constraints or optimization in biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究如何在降阶模型中整合含噪和不完整观测数据
summary_zh.method: 提出基于隐马尔可夫链的概率POD-Galerkin降阶模型框架
summary_zh.result: 仿真实验证明所提框架能够有效处理观测不确定性
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真案例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: This work aims to integrate noisy and incomplete observations into the construction of reduced-order models.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic framework for POD-Galerkin reduced-order models is proposed based on a hidden Markov chain that infers the uncertainty of hidden states.
summary_en.result: Simulations demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively handles observation uncertainty and improves model accuracy.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through simulation case studies.

papers.title: Microstructure and properties of FeCrMoVC tool steel produced by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: IFW Dresden, Institute for Complex Materials, P.O. Box 27 01 16, D-01171 Dresden, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: J. Sander
corresponding_authors.affiliation: IFW Dresden, Institute for Complex Materials, P.O. Box 27 01 16, D-01171 Dresden, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究工具钢的SLM工艺，与生物医用植入物的应力遮挡、多孔结构或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies a non-biomedical tool steel (FeCrMoVC) and does not address porous structures for stress shielding, LPBF for implants, fatigue testing, or surface properties for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索SLM工艺对FeCrMoVC工具钢微观组织及力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备试样，进行微观表征与力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 获得了高致密度、细晶组织及优异硬度与强度。
summary_zh.validation: 实验验证：金相、XRD、硬度及拉伸测试。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of producing FeCrMoVC tool steel via selective laser melting and to characterize its microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: FeCrMoVC samples were fabricated using selective laser melting and subjected to microstructural analysis (SEM, XRD) and mechanical testing (hardness, tensile).
summary_en.result: The as-built material exhibited high relative density, refined microstructure, and superior hardness and tensile strength compared to conventionally processed tool steels.
summary_en.validation: Validation through microstructural characterization (SEM, XRD) and standardized mechanical tests (hardness, tensile).

papers.title: Dynamic Balance and Functional Performance in Total Hip Arthroplasty

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not perform any biomechanical modeling, stress analysis, or finite element analysis of the hip implant, nor does it quantify stress shielding or micromotion.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估全髋关节置换术后的动态平衡和功能表现

summary_en.motivation: Investigate dynamic balance and functional performance outcomes after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Clinical functional tests were conducted on patients.
summary_en.result: No specific results are reported in the abstract.
